meta.siteTitle: Sama Hotel — Jabal Al Akhdar, Oman
meta.siteDescription: Book direct at Sama Hotel, a mountain resort at 2,000 m in Jabal Al Akhdar, Oman. Pay at the hotel — no online payment needed.
meta.homeTitle: Mountain resort in Jabal Al Akhdar — book direct
meta.roomsDescription: Six room types at Sama Hotel, Jabal Al Akhdar: deluxe rooms, family rooms, chalets and suites with mountain or city views. From OMR 50 per night, pay at the hotel.

home.heroTitle: Where the mountain slows the day down
home.heroSubtitle: Rooms, suites and chalets on the edge of the canyon in Oman’s Green Mountain. Book directly with us and pay when you arrive.
home.heroImageAlt: The canyon below Sama Hotel in Jabal Al Akhdar at golden hour

altitude.title: Views from 2,000 m
altitude.body: Every room faces either the canyon and the sunset or Sayq village and the sunrise.

peak.title: The Peak coffee shop
peak.body: Speciality coffee on the terrace above the canyon, open 07:00–22:00 every day.

season.title: Pomegranate & rose season
season.body: Rose water in April, pomegranates from September — the terraces are a short walk away.

cool.title: 10–15 °C cooler than Muscat
cool.body: Clear skies for stargazing at night and a jumper in the evening, even in summer.

pool.title: Pool & jacuzzi on the cliff
pool.body: An outdoor pool and jacuzzi right on the edge, with a children's pool beside it.

home.roomsIntro: Every room faces either the canyon and the sunset, or the village and the sunrise. Prices are per night; taxes are shown separately when you book.
home.roomsUnavailable: Room details are not available right now. Please call or WhatsApp us and we will help you book.
home.locationBody: Take the road through Nizwa and Birkat Al Mouz, then climb. The last stretch, with the canyon opening beside you, is the best part of the drive.
home.fourWdTitle: A 4WD is required past the checkpoint
home.fourWdBody: The police checkpoint at Birkat Al Mouz does not allow two-wheel-drive cars up the mountain. Without a 4WD, park at the checkpoint and let us bring you up.
home.fuelTip: Fill up in Nizwa or Birkat Al Mouz — it is the last petrol station before the climb.
home.payAtHotelTitle: Book direct, pay when you arrive
home.payAtHotelBody: No deposit and no card details online. Your booking is confirmed by email and WhatsApp, and you settle by cash or card at check-in.
home.welcomeTitle: Two thousand metres up, the air changes and so does the pace
home.welcomeBody: Sama sits in Sayq, above the terraces where roses bloom in April and pomegranates ripen in September. Mornings begin with coffee on the cliff; evenings end under a sky full of stars, ten degrees cooler than the coast.

peak.title: Coffee above the canyon
peak.body: The Peak, our coffee shop on the terrace, opens at seven for the sunrise and stays open until ten for the last of the light.

pool.title: A pool on the cliff edge
pool.body: An outdoor pool and jacuzzi right on the edge, with a shallow pool for children beside it and loungers that face the drop.

terraces.title: Rose water and pomegranates
terraces.body: The terraced villages are a short walk away. Come in April for the rose harvest, September for pomegranates, any month for the quiet.

peak.title: Coffee above the canyon
peak.intro: The Peak is our speciality coffee shop on the terrace at the edge of the canyon — the best seat on the mountain for sunrise, sunset and everything in between.
peak.body1: The coffee is taken seriously — single-origin espresso, pour-overs and Omani coffee with dates — but the terrace is the reason to come. In the evening it becomes the quietest place on the mountain to watch the lights of Sayq come on.
peak.body2: Open to hotel guests and visitors alike. No reservation needed — on weekends, come early for a seat at the edge.
peak.imageAlt2: The Peak terrace in the evening

contact.title: We are here to help
contact.intro: For bookings, questions about the road up, or anything else — WhatsApp is the quickest way to reach the reservations team.

policies.title: Hotel policies
policies.intro: The short version of how things work at Sama Hotel. If anything is unclear, ask us — we would rather you knew before you arrive.
policies.checkTimesBody: Check-in from {checkIn}, check-out by {checkOut}. Early check-in and late check-out depend on availability — message us on the day.
policies.childrenBody: Children under {age} stay free in their parents' room using existing bedding. An extra bed is OMR {price} per night, on request. A cot for infants is free.
policies.petsBody: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
policies.smokingBody: All rooms are non-smoking. A shisha area is available outside.
policies.paymentBody: Payment is made at the hotel on arrival, by cash or card. We do not take online payments or card details when you book.
policies.taxesBody: Prices are shown per night before taxes. A service charge of {service}%, a tourism fee of {tourism}% and VAT of {vat}% are added as separate lines on your quote and on your bill.
policies.fourWdBody: A 4WD vehicle is required by the police checkpoint at Birkat Al Mouz. Guests without a 4WD can park at the checkpoint car park and book our 4WD transfer with their room — see Transfers & activities below.

addons.transferUpInstruction: Park at the Birkat Al Mouz checkpoint car park — 2WD cars are not allowed past the checkpoint. Our 4WD collects you there and drives you up to the hotel (about 45 minutes).
addons.transferDownInstruction: On your check-out day our 4WD takes you and your luggage back down to your car at the checkpoint car park.
addons.paidAtHotel: Add-ons are paid at the hotel together with your room. Nothing has been charged.
addons.homeTitle: Two things worth booking with your room
addons.homeIntro: Pick them on the review step when you book. Both are confirmed by the hotel and paid with your room when you arrive.
addons.homeFootnote: Prices are for hotel guests and are added to your bill at the hotel.
addons.apexCardBody: 310 m over the canyon at up to 60 km/h — the launch platform is a short walk from the hotel.
addons.transferCardBody: No 4WD? Park at the Birkat Al Mouz checkpoint and our 4WD brings you up — and back down after check-out.

policy.title: Transfers & activities
policy.checkpoint: Two-wheel-drive cars are not allowed past the Birkat Al Mouz police checkpoint. Guests without a 4WD park at the checkpoint car park; the drive up to the hotel takes about 45 minutes.
policy.transfer: Our 4WD transfer is priced per car (up to {guests} guests) each way — up from the checkpoint on arrival and back down after check-out. Add it when you book and tell us your expected arrival time.
policy.transferPriced: Our 4WD transfer costs {price} per car (up to {guests} guests) each way — up from the checkpoint on arrival and back down after check-out. Add it when you book and tell us your expected arrival time.
policy.apex: APEX Zipline rides are booked with your room at a special rate for hotel guests. Maximum rider weight is {kg} kg; children ride with a guardian's consent; closed-toe shoes are required and rides depend on the weather.
policy.apexPriced: APEX Zipline rides are {price} per rider when booked with your room — a special rate for hotel guests. Maximum rider weight is {kg} kg; children ride with a guardian's consent; closed-toe shoes are required and rides depend on the weather.
policy.confirmation: Add-ons are requested with your booking and confirmed by the hotel, usually on WhatsApp within a few hours. They are paid at the hotel together with your room — nothing is charged online.
policy.cancellation: Cancelling a booking cancels its add-ons too, under the same cancellation policy as the room. To change only an add-on, message us on WhatsApp.

apex.title: 310 metres over the canyon
apex.subtitle: A zipline that starts a short walk from the hotel and flies over the terraces at up to 60 km/h.
apex.heroAlt: A rider on the APEX Zipline above the Jabal Al Akhdar canyon
apex.aboutTitle: From the hotel to Layali Al Jabal Al Akhdar
apex.fallbackDescription: Fly 310 metres across the canyon, about 20 metres above the terraces of Al Aqar, Al Shraija and Al Ain, at up to 60 km/h. The launch platform is a short walk from the hotel and the ride ends at Layali Al Jabal Al Akhdar. Hotel guests pay a special rate; we book your slot for the day you prefer and you pay with your room.

route.start: Launch platform — a short walk from Sama Hotel.
route.over: 310 m across the canyon, about 20 m above the terraces of Al Aqar, Al Shraija and Al Ain.
route.end: Landing at Layali Al Jabal Al Akhdar, a few minutes' walk back.

safety.weather: Rides depend on the weather — in strong wind or rain the operator reschedules.
safety.children: Children ride with a guardian's consent; tell us their ages when you book.

apex.priceUnavailable: Special rate for hotel guests — ask us for today's price.
apex.priceNote: A special rate for Sama Hotel guests, added to your room bill and paid at the hotel.
apex.howStep1: Choose your dates and room, then add riders on the review step.
apex.howStep2: Tell us your preferred day and any riders under 16 — we book the slot with APEX.
apex.howStep3: We confirm by WhatsApp; you pay with your room at check-out.
apex.ctaHint: Already booked? Message us on WhatsApp and we will add it.

footer.tagline: A small mountain hotel at 2,000 metres in Jabal Al Akhdar, Oman — cool air, canyon views and an honest welcome.
